import torch
import torch_npu
from torch._subclasses.fake_tensor import FakeTensorMode

with FakeTensorMode():
    tokens = torch.ones(100, 64).npu().to(torch.bfloat16)
    indices = torch.randint(0, 8, (100, 4)).npu()
    permuted, sorted_indices = torch_npu.npu_moe_token_permute(tokens, indices)
    probs = torch.full((100, 4), 0.25).npu().to(torch.float32)
    grad = torch.ones(100, 64).npu().to(torch.bfloat16)
    grad_tokens, grad_probs = torch_npu.npu_moe_token_unpermute_grad(
        permuted_tokens=permuted, grad_unpermuted_tokens=grad,
        sorted_indices=sorted_indices, probs=probs,
        padded_mode=False, restore_shape=None)
    assert grad_tokens.dtype == permuted.dtype
    assert grad_probs.dtype == probs.dtype
    assert grad_probs.shape == probs.shape
print("META_CONTRACT_ONLY: no device kernel result validated")

import torch
import torch_npu

torch.manual_seed(20261110)
tokens = torch.ones((1024, 6144), device="npu", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
indices = ((torch.arange(1024, device="npu")[:, None] +
            torch.arange(4, device="npu")[None, :]) % 8).contiguous()
permuted, sorted_indices = torch_npu.npu_moe_token_permute(tokens, indices)
probs = torch.full((1024, 4), 0.25, device="npu", dtype=torch.float32)
grad = torch.ones((1024, 6144), device="npu", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
grad_tokens, grad_probs = torch_npu.npu_moe_token_unpermute_grad(
    permuted_tokens=permuted, grad_unpermuted_tokens=grad,
    sorted_indices=sorted_indices, probs=probs,
    padded_mode=False, restore_shape=None)
torch.npu.synchronize()
# d(sum_h y_h)/d(prob[t,k]) = hidden_size for all-one tokens/grad.
assert grad_tokens.dtype == torch.bfloat16
assert grad_probs.dtype == torch.float32
assert tuple(grad_probs.shape) == (1024, 4)
assert torch.equal(grad_probs, torch.full_like(grad_probs, 6144.0))
assert torch.equal(grad_tokens, torch.full_like(grad_tokens, 0.25))
print("DIRECT_BACKWARD_CONTRACT_AND_CLOSED_FORM_REFERENCE_PASS")

designs.inputs: self FLOAT32[32768] ND/stride1，值0..32767；index INT32[L]，值i%32768；L=383/384/385/1535/1536/1537；out FLOAT32[L]。另self=[25599]/[25600]，L=1536作102400字节阈值控制。 扩展INT64候选L=191/192/193/1535/1536/1537，须先核对目标API类型支持；不得把合法性待核验候选记为已执行。
designs.target_path: 要求Ops::NN::AclnnUtil::IsRegbase()==false；mode初值1，经CheckParams引用改写后进入GatherV2WithImplMode。记录index numel与字节数，不将二者混用。
designs.reference: 数值为self[index]精确拷贝；正确mode=0当self_bytes<102400或index_numel<1536，否则mode=1。
designs.expected_failure: 旧INT32 index计数可多4倍：L=1535时旧mode1、新mode0。普通数据可能两版均正确，必须核对分派而非仅看数值。
designs.acceptance: trace/log得到正确mode及目标消费路径；Regbase路径不同或未记录mode时为PATH_NOT_REACHED。数值/完成性仍须核验。
designs.environment_capability: 现有ACL runner可落实该小规模配方；本机只检验host谓词参考，不链接/执行Gather。
designs.code:
def gather_mode(self_numel, self_itemsize, index_numel, index_itemsize, old):
    xbytes = self_numel * self_itemsize
    count = index_numel * (index_itemsize if old else 1)
    return 0 if xbytes < 102400 or count < 1536 else 1

assert gather_mode(32768, 4, 1535, 4, old=True) == 1
assert gather_mode(32768, 4, 1535, 4, old=False) == 0
assert gather_mode(32768, 4, 1536, 4, old=False) == 1
assert gather_mode(25599, 4, 1536, 4, old=False) == 0
assert gather_mode(25600, 4, 1536, 4, old=False) == 1
